title: Pure Adamancipator
summary: Adamancipator cards with generic staples. Block Dragon, the old engine the page covers historically, is Forbidden. The Adamancipator Tuners summon themselves and excavate five cards to summon a Rock, and the Crystals pay you back when an Adamancipator summons them and recycle the matching Synchro onto the top of your Deck. The Beyond the Brave cards lead: Conductor stacks a card on top to summon itself, Mates searches any Adamancipator monster, Crystal - Tiamite searches and summons, and Risen - Tiamite bounces cards on the opponent's turn. Every Rock in the Deck makes the excavations better, so the staples are kept to a minimum.
